reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin whose primary purpose is applying a Death Stranding-inspired theme, with a secondary live ECG visualization driven by session activity snapshots.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供死亡搁浅风格主题，并根据智能体活动显示实时心电图样式的状态波形。
summaries.en: Applies a Death Stranding-inspired theme to the DeepSeek Harness web interface and displays an ECG-style activity waveform based on agent session state.

capabilities: Applies a visual theme to the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Reads session activity snapshots to reflect agent thinking and tool execution state
